about.title: Mr. Ny Rithy
about.subtitle: Founder, CEO & Master Trainer
about.bio: With over 5 years of experience in Cambodian martial arts and fitness, Mr. Ny Rithy has dedicated his life to preserving and teaching the ancient combat traditions of the Khmer Empire while integrating modern strength and conditioning science.
about.philosophy: True mastery comes from the harmony of ancient discipline and modern science. Every student is guided to discover their inner warrior through structured progression, respect, and relentless dedication.
about.heritageText: Cambodia's martial traditions span over a millennium. Bokator, one of the oldest fighting systems in Southeast Asia, was practiced by Angkorian warriors. Yuthakram Khom represents the comprehensive Khmer combat science. Pradal Serey (Kun Khmer) is the modern ring sport descended from these ancient arts.
